annotations.title: Tire size change: diameter and speedometer

description: Use for "what changes if I go from 265/70R17 to 285/75R17", "how far off is my speedometer with 33s", or odometer error after a tire change. Returns diameter, width, sidewall and ride-height change, the true speed when the speedometer shows a given value, the odometer error and how serious it is.

new_tire.description: New tire. Metric like 265/70R17 (P or LT prefix allowed) or flotation like 33x12.50R17; no load index or speed rating.

old_tire.description: Factory or current tire. Metric like 265/70R17 (P or LT prefix allowed) or flotation like 33x12.50R17; no load index or speed rating.
